m1-pipeline-fallback.title: pipeline._build_prior_root: best-effort as-of-N with explicit cross-season fallback
m1-pipeline-fallback.imperative: TDD (test-after allowed, but write the unit test for both paths). Add a frozen PriorBuildResult(prior_mode, prior_through_round) and make _build_prior_root return it: try the as-of-N run_year/copy; on failure (any Exception from run_year or a missing summary) leave NO <period>/compound_prior/2025 dir (only the copied 2018-2024 train-year priors), log an explicit fallback message naming period + cutoff N + cross-season, and return PriorBuildResult('cross_season_fallback', 0). On success return PriorBuildResult('as_of_n', N). run_cutoff_period propagates prior_mode/prior_through_round onto PeriodPredictions. Add the unit test: mock run_year to raise -> cross_season_fallback/0 recorded AND no 2025 dir created; run_year succeeds -> as_of_n/N recorded.

postconditions.statement: PriorBuildResult carries prior_mode/through_round; failed as-of-N build no longer raises, records cross_season_fallback/0 and leaves no 2025 dir; success records as_of_n/N; new pipeline unit tests pass
